strings: r_c0 examines m_c as {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} parent holds {PRONOUN/m_c/object} by the scruff, checking on a leg that is becoming twisted as the kit grows.

When m_c tries to toddle around, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/seem/seems} to be slower than {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} siblings. A quick inspection reveals that one of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} legs was born twisted and deformed, but {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} should find {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} footing in life soon enough.
